name: Bello — long compound artifact and enchantment filter applies
notes: Memory: project_bello_fix_addtype_length_2026-04-06. Bello's 90-character filter ('non-Equipment artifacts and non-Aura enchantments you control with mana value 4 or greater') exceeded a 50-char guard so no effects were emitted. Only non-Equipment artifacts and non-Aura enchantments with MV 4+ become 4/4 Elemental creatures with indestructible and haste during your turn.
